name: Premium Userbot Hoster Bot
description: Telegram Userbot Hoster with Force-Join Gate, Session Management, and Tagall Engine

BOT_TOKEN.description: BotFather se mila hua Telegram Bot Token

OWNER_ID.description: Bot Owner ka numeric Telegram User ID

FORCE_JOIN_CHAT_ID.description: Jis group/channel ka force-join check karna hai uska chat ID (jaise -1001234567890). Khali chhodne par force-join off rahega.

FORCE_JOIN_LINK.description: Force-join group/channel ka invite link (jaise https://t.me/+AbCdEfGhIjK)

SUPPORT_GROUP_URL.description: Support / My Network group ka link

START_BANNER_URL.description: Start message ki banner image URL ya Telegram file_id

CRAFTED_BY.description: Start caption mein dikhne wala creator tag

MONGO_URI.description: Optional MongoDB connection string agar aap persistent DB use kar rahe hain
